requirement_lifecycle_observed: All named requirements are verified/evolving; changed contracts need guarded SRS updates before behavior implementation.

raw_path_feasibility.verdict: Not implementable through the existing TinyHttpd3.1.0 public parser/handler/filter API while retaining the prior full raw-socket path acceptance criteria.
raw_path_feasibility.reason: The parser rejects decoded path==null before dispatching any application handler/filter. RequestURI exposes raw input only for accepted requests. There is no raw-path validation policy/parser hook in the published Builder/ServerConfig API.
raw_path_feasibility.binary_api_evidence: javap inspected the published3.1.0 TinyHttpd.Builder and ServerConfig; no raw/parser/path policy hook.

actual_socket_probe.method: Loopback ephemeral-port TinyHttpd with handler hit counter; raw GET HTTP/1.1, Host localhost, Connection close

unsupported_shortcuts: A NaruServe rawPath accessor cannot intercept requests already rejected by the engine.
Adding an ordinary TinyHttpd filter cannot run before parser rejection.
Source-only composite patches with unchanged Maven3.1.0 dependency do not provide a correct published consumer.
Reflection, class shadowing, rewriting dependency bytecode or silently weakening HTTP parser security are not a supported public-API solution.

decision_options.description: Keep TinyHttpd3.1.0, implement all available common routing/deferred behaviors, and explicitly obtain user agreement to revise #59/#60 raw-socket acceptance to the transport-supported domain. Existing engine rejections must be documented as an approved boundary, never reported as full raw parity.

If user explicitly permits updating the existing TinyHttpd dependency (without adding new libraries), add a secure opt-in upstream raw-routing policy with TDD, publish a new dependency release, and pin/test that binary in NaruServe. No external writes or version bump were authorized by this research.

raw_path_feasibility.independent_work_unblocked: Core matcher/registration/lifetime, Java Pattern API, Servlet async implementation, extension regression and documentation can progress under their own SRS contracts; do not block the whole core on this transport decision.

deferred_lifetime.spi: HttpExchange/ExchangeHandler already allow completion after handle returns; avoid inventing mandatory new abstract methods unless needed by a frozen contract.
deferred_lifetime.tiny_existing_support: TinyHttpdExchange.run waits ended CountDownLatch; finish/abort wake it; raw-target SPI test exchangeOutlivesHandle demonstrates delayed ordinary response.
deferred_lifetime.tiny_stream_gap: run snapshots registered drain once after handle returns, marks handlerReturned and prohibits later eventStream; delayed SSE requires a wait/wakeup/drain-state redesign in addition to core lifetime changes.
deferred_lifetime.resource_limit: Existing TinyHttpd holds a worker while deferred response waits. Semantic async completion is feasible without new dependencies, but nonblocking capacity is not established and must not be claimed.
deferred_lifetime.servlet_gap: NaruServeServlet.service calls adapter.leave in finally after initial handler return. ServletExchange.finish only flushes; ordinary requests never start AsyncContext. SSE alone starts AsyncContext.
servlet_design_work: Own ordinary AsyncContext from before the initial handler may defer; distinguish synchronous completion from pending request.
Keep admitted exchange in-flight until terminal completion/abort rather than initial callback return.
Complete exactly once on success/error/timeout/disconnect/shutdown, preserving stream write ownership and existing SSE capacity contract.
Avoid imposing SSE max-stream/executor limits on ordinary asynchronous requests.
Allow late stream registration if core contract supports it; remove old before-return assumptions only with behavior tests.

servlet_raw_path.current_raw_mapping: ServletPath.remainder uses requestURI minus context and servlet prefix without decoding; NaruServeServlet invokes it before constructing exchange.
servlet_raw_path.existing_test_matrix: ServletRawTargetTest sends invalid percent/UTF8, encoded slash/NUL, literal/encoded dot segments and OPTIONS* over real Jetty; currently expects400/404 and documentation matching. These old expectations do not prove new Express parity.
servlet_raw_path.existing_configurable_seam: Pinned Jetty9.4.58 HttpConnectionFactory.setHttpCompliance(HttpCompliance) is public. HttpComplianceSection has NO_AMBIGUOUS_PATH_SEGMENTS, NO_AMBIGUOUS_PATH_SEPARATORS, NO_AMBIGUOUS_PATH_PARAMETERS, NO_UTF16_ENCODINGS, NO_AMBIGUOUS_EMPTY_SEGMENT, NO_AMBIGUOUS_PATH_ENCODING. Jetty Request.setMetaData calls HttpCompliance.checkUriCompliance before normal handling.
servlet_raw_path.important_version_detail: There is no org.eclipse.jetty.http.UriCompliance class in this pinned9.4.58 jar; use its existing HttpCompliance API rather than newer Jetty APIs/dependencies.
servlet_raw_path.feasibility: Can investigate supported container configuration using existing test dependencies. Full raw-path matrix remains unproven; do not infer that every path including NUL is possible from a configurable ambiguity API alone.
servlet_raw_path.test_support: ContainerRule starts embedded Jetty9.4 on port0, offers webApp before-start hook and plain servlet context helpers; initializer already setAsyncSupported(true). Retain existing container and configure test connector if required; no added servlet/Jetty dependency.
